x: Joe Wilson, Bert Joels, Jack Tilling, Percy Reading, and Bert Mitchell (better known as a cross-country and marathon runner, also as a bee-keeper) made the grade both on the walk and on the grub-stakes.

The winner of the event was our Poly member, Percy Reading, who set up three new records, viz., 19 hours: 105 miles, 466 yards, 110 miles: 19 hours, 57 minutes, 16 seconds, and 20 hours: 110 miles, 410 yards.
